title: Substitution with fixed normalized reindexing primitives
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and an isomorphism g:X→Y with l invertible. For every PodCompletionReindex D and PodCompletedTensorReindex T over D satisfying their Laws, PodReindexSubstitution g D T holds. Thus there are completed-operation models on the two Bool locations and tensor realization comparisons with precisely the specified calculi, completion comparisons, Roos models and pullback realization from D. The primitive normalized pullback equation equals D.limit itself; T.Model and T.Canonical are retained. These same models satisfy ComparisonLaws, SubstitutionLaw and StructuralLaw for whole normalized systems. Definitions: [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-pod-completion-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-tensor-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization], [def-pod-completion-reindex-substitution].

lean.statement:
theorem podReindexingTensorSubstitution
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D)
    (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T) :
    PodReindexSubstitution l E g D T
